points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report predates M080/Re200 later runs and honestly states older status; final response admits no vortex street. Report incorrectly claims no full mesh replication and early M2 convergence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Selected-session copy and plot events plus exact pixel reproduction bind later M080 np1 force/residual to data; exact historical binary and other images remain unbound.
